season.evidence: Web search: Obstruction Point Road closed winter/spring, usually open by June to July; no official snow-free guide, trip reports Jul-Sep. Logged successes Jul-Sep (9/20/13).

track.why: Only one route is stored on this peak. The Jul 5 track runs from Obstruction Point via Grand Pass to Cameron Pass, then east along the ridge to the summit (56 m from Peakbagger's surveyed point) and back; matches the described line.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jul 15 good line to the summit but track ends off the trailhead (incomplete)
Sep 19 track tops out 481 m from Peakbagger's summit, though its report names West Peak as the high point

pins.name: Mount Cameron summit (West Peak)
pins.evidence: Our pin is 423 m ESE of Peakbagger's surveyed highest point (West Peak, lidar 7194 ft). Highest points of tracks 2907374 (3 m) and 2896618 (56 m) agree with the surveyed point; a Sep 2026 report calls West Peak the high point.
pins.confirmedBy: Peakbagger surveyed coordinate (packet) plus two recorded tracks

facts.text: The highest top is the steep-blocked West Peak; the broad, flat East Peak is clearly lower, so make sure you reach the west end of the ridge.
In September, parties stayed below and to the side of the crest, which avoids the most technical Class 3 false summit near the top.
From Cameron Pass it is about 1.5 miles east along the ridge, with the scrambling mostly in the last half mile (mid July).
Dropping straight off the ridge toward Lost Peak in September ran into cliff bands and fourth-class ground; go back along the ridge instead.

notes: Stored pro_tip says the true summit is East; Peakbagger lidar and a Sep 2026 report say West Peak is highest, so that tip should be corrected. Summit pin moved to match.
